'''Paddlefish''' is food obtained within the [[Gauntlet]], healing 20 [[Hitpoints]]. Paddlefish can be obtained by fishing [[raw paddlefish]] with a [[crystal harpoon (The Gauntlet)|crystal harpoon]] and cooking it on the range in the starting room. The paddlefish can burn, producing [[burnt fish (paddlefish)|burnt paddlefish]]. It will stop burning at [[Cooking]] level 47.

They can be upgraded to [[crystal paddlefish]] with an additional 10 [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]]. This reduces the healing from 20 to 16, but also makes it a [[fast food#combo eating|combo food]].
